Delivered the complete independent ACVC cluster B02 scientific review for the fixed task at 28ae2fe7b76a78c73cc39d4d0ece4df3497fb775:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/80be57f9e95818666f336e5fe89791875dc63425/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260913_cluster_b02_scientific_review/archive/RESPONSE.md

The review finds no result-invalidating defect in the supplied record and preserves B02's separate UP readings and the two-observed-endpoint claim ceiling. It identifies two bounded wording findings for the DM response: narrow the blanket future-comparator requirement and clarify the third-fit stopping rationale in terms of decision value. Further independent replication is optional evidence, not an empirical repair prerequisite. DM retains final scientific and lifecycle decisions; this review is not funding, lifecycle or execution approval.

The task's per-path evidence commits are preserved, including d0d6055387a01b545c4c1f7fee01dac9f57ec046 for B02 evidence, be76f696cb773f2e5db8f4d55ebff1f3b6335ae6 for Binding, and 4dfdb5f8f8b377eea29006d0715a737429c719bc for current methods. The verified commit adds only the specified response file. No source, card, previous response, main or scientific state was changed; no scientific execution or outcome reanalysis occurred.
